title: Google\Cloud\Datastore\DatastoreSessionHandler
name: DatastoreSessionHandler
description: Custom session handler backed by Cloud Datastore.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Create a custom session handler backed by Cloud Datastore.

params.name: gcLimit
params.description: A number of entities to delete in the garbage collection. Defaults to 0 which means it does nothing. The value larger than 1000 will be cut down to 1000.

params.name: options.entityOptions
params.description: Default options to be passed to the {@see \Google\Cloud\Datastore\DatastoreClient::entity()} method when writing session data to Datastore. If not specified, defaults to ['excludeFromIndexes' => ['data']].

methods.name: open
methods.description: Start a session, by creating a transaction for the later write.

params.name: savePath
params.description: The value of session.save_path setting will be used here. It will use this value as the Datastore namespaceId.

params.name: sessionName
params.description: The value of session.name setting will be used here. It will use this value as the Datastore kind.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read the session data from Cloud Datastore.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Write the session data to Cloud Datastore.

params.name: data
params.description: The session data to write to the %1$s.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Delete the session data from Cloud Datastore.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Delete the old session data from Cloud Datastore.
